$comment: Pinned upstream sources of the vendored protobuf definitions. 'commit', 'files' and 'updated' are written by protobuf/update.sh; everything else is edited by hand.

consensus-node.description: The Hiero API (HAPI). The base every other node type imports from: 'services' holds the transaction and query definitions, 'block' the block stream, 'streams' the record stream, 'platform' the consensus internals.

block-node.description: The block node's own service definitions ('block-node/api') and its internal state messages ('internal'). They import 'block/stream/*' from the consensus node.

mirror-node.description: The mirror node's gRPC API (the REST API is specified in OpenAPI, not protobuf). Imports 'services/*' from the consensus node.
